## Fluorescence-Guided Surgery Imaging System {#path-imaging}

```{=html}
<div class="project">
  <div class="project-img">
    <img src="https://placehold.co/400x300?text=Photo+Coming+Soon" alt="Fluorescence-guided surgery imaging system">
  </div>
  <div class="project-text">
    <p><strong>Role:</strong> Mechanical Engineer, PATH Imaging &nbsp;|&nbsp; September 2026 – Present</p>
    <p><strong>Overview:</strong><br>
      A low-cost, Raspberry Pi–based dual-camera system that overlays fluorescence imaging onto
      live visible-light video to guide surgeons. I'm working with a 7-person team and a PATH Imaging
      liaison to deliver this at a fraction of the cost of commercial systems.</p>
    <p><strong>Skills:</strong><br>
      CAD, 3D Printing, Optical Mounting &amp; Alignment, Raspberry Pi, Embedded Firmware, Real-Time Image Processing</p>
  </div>
</div>

<details class="more">
  <summary></summary>
  <div class="detail-grid">
    <div>
      <strong>Camera Mounting (CAD)</strong>
      <img src="https://placehold.co/400x300?text=Photo+Coming+Soon" alt="Camera mount CAD">
      <p>Leading CAD for the full camera mounting assembly, designing 3D-printed adapters that fit
        16 mm and 25 mm C-mount lenses onto the Vision Components IMX412 RGB and TechNexion NIR
        fluorescence camera modules with precise alignment.</p>
    </div>
    <div>
      <strong>Firmware &amp; Image Processing</strong>
      <img src="https://placehold.co/400x300?text=Photo+Coming+Soon" alt="Video overlay">
      <p>Developing firmware and image-processing code to capture, synchronize, and overlay the
        fluorescence and visible-light video feeds in real time.</p>
    </div>
    <div>
      <strong>Team &amp; Sponsor</strong>
      <img src="https://placehold.co/400x300?text=Photo+Coming+Soon" alt="Team">
      <p>Collaborating with a 7-person team and a PATH Imaging liaison to meet clinical needs on a
        tight budget.</p>
    </div>
  </div>
</details>
```

## Underwater Seafloor Mapping Robot {#e79-seafloor-mapping}

```{=html}
<div class="project">
  <div class="project-img">
    <img src="https://placehold.co/400x300?text=Photo+Coming+Soon" alt="Underwater seafloor mapping robot">
  </div>
  <div class="project-text">
    <p><strong>Role:</strong> Project Lead, Harvey Mudd E79 &nbsp;|&nbsp; January 2026 – June 2026</p>
    <p><strong>Overview:</strong><br>
      I led a four-person team to build a seafloor mapping system on a $50 budget. It combines laser
      triangulation and Raspberry Pi imaging to generate 3D topographic maps in MATLAB, mounted on an
      underwater diving robot.</p>
    <p><strong>Skills:</strong><br>
      Team Leadership, Laser Triangulation, Raspberry Pi, MATLAB, Sensor Design, Prototyping &amp; Testing</p>
  </div>
</div>

<details class="more">
  <summary></summary>
  <div class="detail-grid">
    <div>
      <strong>Sensors</strong>
      <img src="https://placehold.co/400x300?text=Photo+Coming+Soon" alt="Sensors">
      <p>Designed and built temperature, pressure, and camera sensors so the diving robot could
        collect data underwater.</p>
    </div>
    <div>
      <strong>Mapping</strong>
      <img src="https://placehold.co/400x300?text=Photo+Coming+Soon" alt="3D topographic map">
      <p>Combined laser triangulation with Raspberry Pi imaging to produce 3D topographic maps of the
        seafloor in MATLAB.</p>
    </div>
    <div>
      <strong>Testing</strong>
      <img src="https://placehold.co/400x300?text=Photo+Coming+Soon" alt="Testing">
      <p>Ran multiple prototyping sessions and dry tests, tuning the mechanical and electrical
        systems for reliable, consistent mobility.</p>
    </div>
  </div>
</details>
```

## Hydrogel Compression Testing Device {#e4-hydrogel-tester}

```{=html}
<div class="project">
  <div class="project-img">
    <img src="https://placehold.co/400x300?text=Photo+Coming+Soon" alt="Hydrogel compression testing device">
  </div>
  <div class="project-text">
    <p><strong>Role:</strong> Project Lead, Harvey Mudd E4 &nbsp;|&nbsp; September 2025 – December 2025</p>
    <p><strong>Overview:</strong><br>
      A low-cost, air-pressure-driven compression tester that lets 4th and 5th graders measure hydrogel
      deformation at school outreach events, using popping boba as a food-safe test material.</p>
    <p><strong>Skills:</strong><br>
      SolidWorks, Machining, Fabrication, Design for Cost, Prototyping, STEM Outreach</p>
  </div>
</div>

<details class="more">
  <summary></summary>

    <div>

      <img src="https://placehold.co/400x300?text=Photo+Coming+Soon" alt="Fabrication">
```
